prompt: Refer to the exhibit. Which set of commands must be applied to the two switches to configure an LACP Layer 2 EtherChannel?

options.label: A
options.text: SW1(config)#interface range f0/13 -14 SW1(config-if-range)#channel-group 1 mode auto SW2(config)#interface range f0/13 -14 SW2(config-if-range)#channel-group 1 mode passive

options.label: B
options.text: SW1(config)#interface range f0/13 -14 SW1(config-if-range)#channel-group 1 mode desirable SW2(config)#interface range f0/13 -14 SW2(config-if-range)#channel-group 1 mode passive

options.label: C
options.text: SW1(config)#interface range f0/13 -14 SW1(config-if-range)#channel-group 1 mode on SW2(config)#interface range f0/13 -14 SW2(config-if-range)#channel-group 1 mode passive
